product.name: Squatch NAM
product.description: A Neural Amp Modeler (.nam) model, run by NeuralAmpModelerCore (pinned in hosts/clap/deps.lock), signal path as the browser rig's NAM head: input gain, the model, output gain (the model's own loudness brought to -18 dBFS when Normalize is on), a 160 Hz low shelf (Bass) and a 10 Hz DC block.

files.name: Model
files.note: A path in the saved state, not a parameter. Loaded off the audio thread and swapped in.

params.name: Output
params.note: After the model's loudness normalisation (to -18 dBFS, as NAM's own plugin does). The rig's Master is -24..24; this range is a superset of it (the old top was 12).

params.name: Bass
params.note: Low shelf at 160 Hz, Q 0.7071 (RBJ cookbook), the rig NAM head's Bass: 0 to -12 dB, after the output gain. 12 ms glide, as the head's coefficient crossfade.

params.name: Normalize
params.note: On: a model that states its loudness is brought to -18 dBFS (the rig head's Norm). Off: the model's own level. Applies while playing, through the Output smoother.

params.name: DC block
params.note: A one-pole 10 Hz DC blocker on the output (y = x - x1 + R y1, R = 1 - 2 pi 10 / rate), the rig head's, last in the path.
